entities.name: 2-Nitro-6-(difluoromethoxy)pyridine
observations: Standardized substrate structure: O=[N+]([O-])c1ncccc1OC(F)F; an aromatic nitro pyridine bearing a difluoromethoxy substituent.

entities.name: 2-Amino-6-(difluoromethoxy)pyridine
observations: Product structure: Nc1ncccc1OC(F)F, also represented as FC(OC=1C(=NC=CC1)N)F.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Fe/NH4Cl in ethanol/water reduces the aromatic nitro group to a primary amino group while retaining the pyridine ring and difluoromethoxy substituent.
Reported yield is approximately 55% at 90 °C; a related record reports 66% under ethanol/acetic acid at 100 °C for 8 hours.
